question: The legendary Kuchipudi dancer and Padma Shri 1970 awardee, V Satyanarayana Sarma was born in _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• V Satyanarayana Sarma was a legendary Kuchipudi dancer and a prominent figure in Indian classical dance.
 
• He was born in the village of Kuchipudi in Andhra Pradesh, which is also the birthplace of the Kuchipudi dance form.
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical Indian dance form that originated in the 17th century and is known for its graceful movements and expressive storytelling.
 
• Sarma was born in 1935 and dedicated his life to preserving and promoting the Kuchipudi tradition.
 
• He was trained under the guidance of renowned gurus, including Vedantam Lakshminarayana Sastri and Chinta Krishnamurthy.
 
• Sarma was known for his exceptional ability to perform both male and female roles in Kuchipudi, a rare skill that showcased his versatility.
 
• He was particularly famous for his portrayal of female characters, which required intricate expressions and delicate movements.
 
• His performances were marked by their emotional depth, technical precision, and adherence to traditional Kuchipudi styles.
 
• In 1970, he was honored with the Padma Shri, one of India's highest civilian awards, for his contributions to the arts.
 
• Sarma also received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1979, further cementing his legacy as a master of Kuchipudi.
 
• He was a dedicated teacher and trained numerous students, ensuring the continuity of the Kuchipudi tradition.
